card.name: Mixed spots in warning and dosing text
card.fires_on: Scattered positions in drug-warning and dosing sentences: commas in lists of risks, 'been' in 'has not been established', and partway through drug names like estazolam, ketorolac tromethamine and anticoagulants.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a long drug name in a sentence about combined use or dosing.
modes.example: prescribe a lower initial dose of chlordiazepoxide and<< am>>itriptyline hydrochloride tablets

modes.label: Linking words in warnings
modes.description: A comma or small verb in a warning or caution sentence.
modes.example: Hypoventilation, airway obstruction<<,>> and apnea can lead to hypox

modes.label: Helper words in cautions
modes.description: Words like 'been' or 'be' that sit inside fixed warning phrasing.
modes.example: for more than 90 doses has not<< been>> established in clinical trials

card.writes: It slightly lowers words that introduce cautions, such as caution, lest and beware, so the text continues without a caution phrase.
card.plain: It fires at scattered points inside warning and dosing sentences, often in the middle of a drug name.
